title: SentinelIncidentAnalysis
description: Schema for advisory incident analysis generated by GitLab Duo during Sentinel recovery attempts.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the analysis schema contract.

incident_id.description: Unique identifier of the incident being investigated.

outcome.description: Verdict of the investigation. Must be explicit to support hands-off abort if no safe fix is found.

facts.description: Confirmed empirical facts extracted from authoritative evidence items (logs, metrics, probes).

fact.description: Description of the confirmed factual observation.

evidence_ref.description: Concrete pointer to the evidence bundle item or log citation (e.g., 'metrics.json#L42', 'cloudrun-logs/candidate-error.log').

hypotheses.description: Plausible explanations of root cause with qualitative or numeric confidence.

confidence.description: Subjective confidence level based on available evidence.

missing_evidence.description: Information or logs that would be needed to prove or refute hypotheses but were absent in the evidence bundle.

suspected_change.description: Commit or diff hunk suspected of introducing the regression.

commit_sha.description: The commit hash suspected of introducing the fault.

file_path.description: File path where regression is believed to originate.

line_range.description: Estimated line numbers or diff range.

reason.description: Why this specific change is suspected.

proposed_fix_summary.description: High-level summary of the proposed code repair and regression test strategy. Required when outcome is 'fix_proposed'.

regression_test_strategy.description: Details regarding the new regression test designed to reproduce the failure.

test_file.description: Path to the regression test under tests/regressions/.

expected_failure_type.description: Expected failure on broken commit (must be an assertion failure).
